name: clanker-ui
description: clanker-ui is a dependency-free port of shadcn/ui (the base-nova style on Base UI) for plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It has no build step, no npm, no framework, and needs no CDN. You write the shadcn markup with `data-slot` attributes, and the kit adds the behavior. Everything runs under a strict Content Security Policy with Trusted Types.
csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'
cspMeta: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'

files.note: Put all files in one directory of the static site. In the repository and in the release zip, the .min files are in dist/; the release also has each file as a separate asset. Use the readable set or the .min files, never both.

optional.use: classic script before the module, for apps with a theme toggle, switch, or scheme picker (no flash of the wrong theme)
accessibility layer; after the themes file (min: clanker-ui-a11y.min.css)
chart, sparkline, and stat tile module (min: clanker-ui-chart.min.js with clanker-ui-chart.min.css)

exports.name: h
exports.notes: Safe DOM builder. Strings and numbers become text nodes. Attributes use `setAttribute`. `on*` props must be functions (`onclick`, `"ontabs:change"`). `style` must be an object (`{ marginTop: "1px", "--x": "2px" }`). `null`, `undefined`, `false` are skipped; `true` sets an empty attribute. Arrays and iterables are flattened. Refuses `<script>`, `<style>`, `<link>`, `<meta>`, `<object>`, `<embed>`, `<base>`, `<frame>`, `<frameset>`, the SVG animation elements `<set>`, `<animate>`, `<animateMotion>`, `<animateTransform>` (they can write a `javascript:` URL into `href`), `srcdoc`, string handlers, and string `style`. `<iframe>` is allowed (`src` is filtered). Drops `javascript:` and `vbscript:` URLs in `href`, `src`, `action`, `formaction`, `xlink:href`, `poster`, `ping`, `cite`, and `background`. If `attrs` is a string, node, or array, it is a child.

exports.name: svg
exports.notes: Same as `h` in the SVG namespace.

exports.name: icon
exports.notes: Lucide icon with `class="lucide lucide-<name>"`. It gets `aria-hidden="true"` unless `attrs` has `role`, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`. `attrs` override the defaults. Unknown names throw. `<svg data-lucide>` follows the same rule.

exports.name: iconNames
exports.notes: All icon names (127). Aliases: `loader-2`, `more-horizontal`, `more-vertical`, `home`, `trash-2`, `filter`, `circle-help`, `smile`.

exports.name: define
exports.notes: Behavior registry, see below. Throws if the slot is already defined.

exports.name: emit
exports.notes: Dispatches a bubbling, composed `CustomEvent`. Returns `false` if a listener called `preventDefault()`.

exports.name: uid
exports.notes: Unique id that is not in the document.

exports.name: ensureId
exports.notes: Returns `el.id`, sets one first if empty.

exports.name: strings
exports.notes: Every fixed UI string of the kit (chart module included), English by default. See [Localization](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui#localization).

exports.name: stringFor
exports.notes: Reads one string with the per-element override. See [Localization](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui#localization).

exports.name: show
exports.notes: Opens a popup, see [Popups](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui#popups).

exports.name: hide
exports.signature: hide(el, { restoreFocus = true, after, focusVisible }?) → Promise
exports.notes: Closes after exit animations finish. `after` (a promise) replaces the wait for the animations on `el`, for parts that animate a child (drawer popup); it closes also when `after` rejects. `focusVisible` sets whether the returned focus shows a ring (default: the rule below).

exports.name: isOpen
exports.notes: `true` between `show` and `hide`.

exports.name: position
exports.signature: position(floating, anchor, { side, align, sideOffset, alignOffset, collisionPadding, flip, lazyFlip, settle }?) → stop()
exports.notes: Places `floating` next to `anchor` (an element or `{ getBoundingClientRect }`) and keeps it placed on scroll and resize. `settle: true` ends a running `left`/`top` transition at each move (select, combobox). After a size change of `floating` or `anchor`, it moves before the next paint, but only if the move does not change its size (an automatic width depends on `left`); otherwise it moves in the next frame. The size variables always change in the next frame. This prevents a `ResizeObserver` loop error. Scroll and window resize place it once per frame.

exports.name: dismissable
exports.signature: dismissable(el, onDismiss(reason, event), { escape, outside, focusOutside, intentional, ignore }?) → release()
exports.notes: Layer stack. Escape closes the top layer. An outside press closes layers from the top down, with the Base UI 1.6.0 `outsidePressEvent` rule for each pointer type. Sloppy (the default): a mouse or pen press closes at `pointerdown`; a touch closes at the end of a tap (the compatibility `mousedown`), at the end of a touch that moved more than 5 px, or during a move of more than 10 px. `intentional` closes only on a main-button `click` outside whose press started outside and did not end in the layer; `true` uses it for all pointers (dialogs, sheets, the mobile sidebar, the navigation menu), `"mouse"` for mouse and pen only (popover, date picker, non-modal drawer), `"touch"` for touch only (combobox). A press that ends with no click (right or middle button, a cancelled touch) does not leave a pending close for a later click. `reason` is `"escape"`, `"outside"`, or `"focus"`. Focus changes during a pointer press never dismiss (WebKit moves focus to a focusable ancestor on press). Pointer down or focus inside an open toast never dismisses a layer.

exports.name: trapFocus
exports.notes: Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside the top trap. Like the Base UI focus guards, it puts a hidden `data-slot="focus-guard"` span (`tabindex="0"`) first and last in `container`; focus on the first goes to the last stop, focus on the last goes to the first stop, and the browser order applies everywhere else.

exports.name: focusFirst
exports.notes: Focuses `[autofocus]`, else the first tabbable outside a toast, else the container.

exports.name: tabbables
exports.notes: Visible, enabled, tabbable elements in order.

exports.name: saveFocus
exports.notes: Focuses `trigger` first when it is in the document and does not have focus (Safari does not focus a button on click). Then remembers `document.activeElement`. `restore(visible)` focuses it again with a ring when `visible` is true or the keyboard is in use; if it already has focus with the wrong ring state, it focuses it again.

exports.name: hideOthers
exports.notes: Sets `aria-hidden="true"` on everything outside `elements` and live regions (`[aria-live]`), as Base UI does for a modal context menu. `release()` removes only what it set.

exports.name: lockScroll
exports.notes: Counted page scroll lock without layout shift.

exports.name: rove
exports.signature: rove(event, items, { orientation = "vertical", loop = true, typeahead = true, focus = true, active, label, ms, skipDisabled = true }?) → Element | null
exports.notes: Call from `keydown`. Handles arrows (RTL aware), Home, End, and typeahead (`ms` goes to `typeahead`). Skips hidden items, and disabled items unless `skipDisabled: false` (menus, as Base UI). Calls `preventDefault()` when it handles the key. With `focus: false` it only returns the next item (use for `aria-activedescendant`).

exports.name: setRoving
exports.notes: Sets `tabindex="0"` on one item and `-1` on the rest.

exports.name: typeahead
exports.signature: typeahead(event, items, { active, label, visible = true, ms = 500 }?) → Element | null
exports.notes: `ms` search buffer (the select uses 750 ms, like Base UI); repeated letters cycle. A space inside the buffer time is part of the search. With `visible: false` it also searches items that are not rendered, for example a closed list.

exports.name: transition
exports.notes: Base UI transition states. Open: sets `data-starting-style` for one frame, so a CSS transition runs from the starting style. Close: sets `data-ending-style` and resolves when the transitions and animations on `el` end; the attribute stays until the next open.

exports.name: afterAnimations
exports.notes: Resolves when the finite animations and transitions on `el` end. Animations on another timeline than `el.ownerDocument.timeline` (scroll-driven animations, for example `.scroll-fade`) do not count.

exports.name: theme
exports.signature: theme.get(), theme.set("light"|"dark"|"system"), theme.resolved(), theme.toggle(), theme.scheme(), theme.setScheme(value), theme.schemes
exports.notes: The mode is stored in `localStorage["clanker-ui-theme"]` and applied as `data-theme` on `<html>`. `resolved()` returns the mode that shows (`dark` for a dark-only scheme). `toggle()` does what the toggle button does. `scheme()` returns `data-scheme` (`""` when there is none). `setScheme` takes names separated by spaces (`a-z`, `0-9`, `-`, at most 200 characters, else a `TypeError`) and stores them in `localStorage["clanker-ui-scheme"]`; `""` removes the scheme. `schemes` is the frozen list `{ value, label, group }` (`group`: `shadcn`, `editor`, or `accent`). See [Color schemes](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui#color-schemes).

exports.name: dialogOpen
exports.notes: Works for `dialog`, `alert-dialog`, `sheet`, and `drawer`.

exports.name: dialogClose
exports.notes: `reason` goes to the `:close` event.

exports.name: traceOpen
exports.notes: `target` is a `trace-collapsible` or an element in it.

exports.name: toast
exports.notes: Sonner-style calls and the Base UI manager (`toast.add`, `toast.update`, `toast.close`), see [Toast and Sonner](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui#toast-and-sonner).

exports.name: calendarGetValue
exports.notes: `"2026-10-28"`, an array (`multiple`), `{ from, to }` (`range`), or `null`.

exports.name: calendarSetValue
exports.signature: calendarSetValue(el, value, { emit = false, month = true }?) → boolean
exports.notes: `month` shows the month of the first selected date.

exports.name: messageScrollerScrollToMessage
exports.signature: messageScrollerScrollToMessage(el, id, { align, behavior, scrollMargin }?) → boolean
exports.notes: Waits for the row if the list is still empty.

exports.name: questionnaireRefresh
exports.notes: Call after you enable or disable an item.

exports.name: chart
exports.signature: chart(element, data, options) → { update(data, options), destroy() }
exports.notes: In `clanker-ui-chart.js`, see [Chart](https://github.com/bl4ko/clanker-ui#chart).

The kit sets `tabindex="-1"` on a horizontal list that has no `tabindex`, so the list is not a Tab stop (Firefox stops on a scroll container).

events.name: carousel:change
events.notes: `{ value: index, count }` (snap index and snap count; also once at start and after a new measure that changes them)

keyboard: The kit adds the carousel and slide roles, slide labels, the arrow icons, and disables a button at the end (`disabled`, `data-disabled`).
Like shadcn, focus does not move when the focused button becomes disabled, so Tab continues to the other button.
The buttons and the arrow keys (RTL aware) move one slide with duration 25 and friction 0.68 (about 750 ms; at once with reduced motion); a press during the motion changes its target.
Tab into a slide jumps to it at once.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
keyboard: Focus moves to the first part in the popup that can take focus (the previous-month button, or the next-month button when the previous one is disabled), as the Base UI popover does; Tab moves to the next-month button, then to the selected day or today.
Escape, an outside click, or focus leaving closes it; a single date selection closes it unless `data-keep-open`.
`data-date-picker-input` on an input (for example in an `input-group`, with an icon button as the trigger) shows the date, parses typed dates on `change`, and opens the popup on ArrowDown.

events.name: chart:active
events.notes: `{ index, key, row }`, or `null` when the tooltip closes

keyboard: Keys that are not in `config` follow in data order.
The SVG is `role="application"` with `tabindex="0"`, so screen readers pass the arrow keys to it.
Keyboard: arrows move between points, Home, End, Escape.
Hover finds the nearest point by time; the arrow keys move through the rows in data order.
